what_changed: CFPB withdrew listed guidance documents, including its advisory opinion on pay-to-pay fees under the FDCPA and Regulation F.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change to the statutory rule: 12 CFR 1006.22(b) still bars fees not authorized by agreement or law. Stop citing the withdrawn advisory opinion as authority in fee scripts or policy.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Do any fee policies rely on the withdrawn advisory opinion's reasoning?
rationale: Notice withdraws guidance on a covered behavior (convenience fees). Withdrawals are changes. Full-text excerpt lists the pay-to-pay opinion.
